info.name: All links become blue
info.description: Should force all links to become blue #0000EE and underscored, regardless of history or current state.  If the pic on this page is covered by ads so that you can't see the sample screenshot, here's a blurry copy (Pinterest, so some finer detail's lost) — sorry for the link, but it seems that the image itself won't show up here: screenshot of Wikipedia with style installed. Sometimes there's no underscore (as with Google results' links, unless hovered over [DuckDuckGo is OK, oddly]) — hence my release note section below. NB: removed `padding: 0 2px 0 2px;` because it tends to make buttons jittery. For a tutorial on writing CSS work skin rules (with a focus on fonts, colors, highlighting, circling, etc. on AO3, and can be used for general CSS purposes), please see Fonts, and colors, and work skins, oh my!.
info.additionalInfo: Might be worthwhile to change from text-decoration: underline to border-bottom: 1px.
